a: Top-up to $30,000 a year (after fees and tuition) through Term 12, a technology grant of up to $2,000, and a desk at Perimeter
dt: No fixed date: submit the expression of interest within one week of your partner-university PhD application (the earliest one if you apply to several)
e: Lets PhD students at a Perimeter partner university do their PhD in residence at Perimeter with a Perimeter-affiliated supervisor. Requires admission to the partner university's PhD program and acceptance by a Perimeter faculty member; it is not itself a PhD application.
n: Perimeter Institute PhD Residency Award (2027 expression of interest)
